title: Beatrix and the Salt
author: Quentin Dravenmoor
blurb: August Winterbourne, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
